clips.send: Someone sends this to the friend who can't figure out why milk upsets their stomach - relief at finally having an answer.
clips.caption:
On The Kevin Trudeau Show, Kevin Trudeau walks through what "processed" actually means for milk: heated to 180 degrees for 30 minutes, then homogenized so the cream never separates.

His view: that heat also wipes out the enzymes that help your body digest it in the first place - part of why homogenized milk sits so much longer on the shelf than the raw kind ever did.

His fix: look for raw, grass-fed or non-homogenized milk where it's legally sold near you.

clips.send: A home cook sends this to the friend who swears by peanut butter toast - anxiety about what's really in the jar.
clips.caption:
On The Kevin Trudeau Show, Kevin Trudeau points to one line on a label: hydrogenated oil, also called trans fat.

His view: it can attach extra cholesterol to the inside of your artery wall, mess with your hormones, and even raise your appetite - the opposite of what most people expect from a "healthy" spread.

His fix: check peanut butter, crackers and baked goods for the word "hydrogenated" before they go in your cart.

What's sitting in your pantry right now with that word on the label?

clips.send: Someone sends this to a roommate who never checks for non-GMO - anxiety they've been grabbing the wrong bag for years.
clips.caption:
On The Kevin Trudeau Show, Kevin Trudeau gives a simple grocery rule: if the package doesn't say "non-GMO," he says to assume the ingredients have been genetically modified.

His view: a guest on his radio show once walked through a long list of symptoms he'd tied back to GMO ingredients - bloating, hormone issues and weight gain among them, a list most shoppers never connect back to their cart.

His fix: look for "non-GMO" or "organic" on the label before anything else.

Do you check for that label, or just the price?

#kevintrudeau #gmo #nongmo #readthelabel #foodtruth #wbdaily

clips.send: A parent sends this to the one who keeps buying the kids' favorite chips - anger at a company hiding an appetite trick on the label.
clips.caption:
On The Kevin Trudeau Show, Kevin Trudeau breaks down monosodium glutamate, MSG, the flavor additive hiding in chips, fast food and "healthy" snack bars.

His view: MSG is an excitotoxin that can make you hungrier, thirstier and more likely to keep eating past full - which he says is exactly why it gets added in the first place.

His rule: flip the bag over. If monosodium glutamate is on the ingredient list, he skips that brand entirely.

Have you checked the back of your favorite chips lately?

#kevintrudeau #msg #monosodiumglutamate #readthelabel #foodadditives #wbdaily

clips.send: A bread lover sends this to the friend who blames every stomach ache on gluten - the relief of finally knowing why.
clips.caption:
On The Kevin Trudeau Show, Kevin Trudeau compares two loaves: wheat from Italy, naturally fermented close to 48 hours, against most American and Canadian wheat, fermented for only about 8 hours.

His view: that shorter fermentation is a big reason high-gluten wheat causes so much gas, bloating and allergic reaction for so many people.

His workaround: he looks for "product of Italy" or "durum wheat" on bread and pasta labels before buying.

Next time you grab a loaf, what does the label actually say?

#kevintrudeau #wheat #gluten #fermentation #readthelabel #wbdaily

clips.send: Someone sends this to a friend who just switched to a 'healthy' vinaigrette - anger at realizing the cheap oil is still in there.
clips.caption:
On The Kevin Trudeau Show, Kevin Trudeau singles out soy, almost all of it grown from genetically modified seed today.

His view: soybean oil in salad dressing can lower testosterone levels, and he says it's usually there because it's the cheapest oil to use, not because it belongs in a vinaigrette.

His swap: skip the soybean, canola or safflower oil and reach for extra virgin olive oil instead.

clips.send: A parent sends this to the one doing the grocery shopping - anger at finding out what's really behind cheap ground beef.
clips.caption:
On The Kevin Trudeau Show, Kevin Trudeau explains what happens before beef reaches the grocery shelf: cows fed genetically modified corn to fatten them faster, on feed that can include ground remains of other animals too sick to enter the food chain.

His view: that's also where much of the antibiotics and growth hormone in ordinary beef comes from.

His rule: look for "100% grass-fed" on the label, for beef and dairy both.
